values.note: 16 river-front sites with wood decks plus 4 pull-through sites in the central 'Quad'. Pull-through lots 18-20 are over 100 ft; lot 17 suits compact rigs. River site 16 is small, best under 30 ft, 20% off on arrival.

values.note: River-front and pull-through sites cost the same: $45 a night in November 2026 (a 3-night-minimum period), $64 a night on every 2027 date read (May and October weeknights, a June Friday-Saturday). Base price covers the RV + 2 persons. No tax added to RV sites.

values.note: Booked on the park's own site, $100 deposit. 2-night minimum; 3 nights through October 2026, 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-05 and the 2026 summer holiday weekends. 'Seasonal and Long Term Stays: We have a very limited number of sites available for extended stays. Please call us.' No pit bulls (insurance).

note: Private boutique RV park (formerly Appalachian Campground, roots in the 1970s, rebuilt 2025) at 1504 Moody Hollow, Hiawassee, on the headwaters of the Hiawassee River; three rental cabins too. Pitched as adult-focused: no pool or playground. --Claude
summary: Operator's site and its own booking search: confirmed full hookups, pull-through, year-round, phone 706-406-3569. Added 50-amp, 20 sites, showers + laundry, fees $45 (Nov 2026) - $64 (2027), operator booking URL with the 2-night minimum (3-night seasons noted). Note trimmed of hookups/site counts/booking; 'under new management 2024' replaced by the operator's own 'reimagined in 2025'.
flags: PRICE GATE: $64 a night on every 2027 date read (river-front and pull-through priced alike; site 16, under 30 ft, is $51 after its 20% discount); only November 2026 is under $50 ($45, with a 3-night minimum). No gateway within 40 km (GSMNP ~85 km); no family stay. Over US$50 with no exception reads as a drop.

MINIMUM STAY: standing 2-night minimum (keepable if marked, now in booking.min_stay), but the booking rules impose 3 nights for all of October 2026 and 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-05, every day of the week, not just weekends/holidays. That is a 3+ night minimum outside weekends/holidays for those months.

WATERFRONT re-audit lead (operator claim contrary to 'not waterfront'): 'Each site is directly on the banks of the Hiawassee River, and each includes a wooden deck'. Esri imagery (pre-2025 rebuild, no decks or RVs visible) shows a gravel lane running NE along the creek, roughly 15-20 m from the bank. Needs newer imagery to place the decks before any upgrade.
Pin (34.82842,-83.73092) sits in the open field west of the creek beside a small building; the river lane and bathhouse loop centre on about 34.8290,-83.7295. Worth confirming against a site map.
Adult-focused ('A Refined Boutique RV park Experience for adult Travelers'), but the booking form takes children; written into the note, not a restriction.
